Final source preserves late correlation and cleanup before retry, six per-identity retained/fair receipts and timed retry independent of device activity. Reviewer confirmed corrections; no reviewer builds/tests.
review.additional: Main review caught replay watermark loss across another owner and Release. Six identity caches survive Release until exact terminal retirement; stale/foreign/replayed mutations fail before effects. Host regressions include accepted late BEGIN reconciliation, Full fairness, cache/ticket exhaustion, actual partial engine bytes and UI queue retention.

limits: Single active outbound service-owned job and one existing diagnostic listener, static fixed endpoint10.0.2.2:46078,4096-byte buffers and256-byte service turns.

Tickets and source ports are finite non-reused service data, not capabilities or Unix descriptors. Authenticated caller/task identity is joined against held BOOT lifecycle catalogs before effects/advance/reply/egress.

One outstanding RPC per caller. Accepted timeouts retain exact correlation; cancellation/retry waits for acknowledged cleanup. No accepted mutation replay or assertion of peer receipt from queue admission.
Private job buffers are scrubbed on cancel/release/failure/retirement; already submitted DMA stays driver-owned until completion/quarantine. Shared protocol caches are retained service state.

Both NICs and controlled peer are QEMU fixtures. Current clock/polling/predictable seed/static addressing, no DNS/HTTP/TLS/useful online web, physical/firmware DMA drain/IOMMU/epoch/SMP gates remain explicit.
